logline: A man who wants to build a shelf buries himself in preparation until the preparation blocks the wall, then drives one screw.

protagonist.wants: to hang one shelf on his bedroom wall
protagonist.flaw: believes the next preparation will make starting safe

scenes.action: stands before the bare wall holding a single screw and does not move
scenes.obstacle: the screw is the only tool he owns
scenes.visual_carrier: man, bare wall, one screw, a tiny stack of unopened boxes behind him

changes.detail: we learn the whole film is one screw away

scenes.leads_to: he decides he needs proper tools first
scenes.narration: It was one screw. He owned the screw.

scenes.action: returns from the shop with a drill, then returns again with a laser level
scenes.obstacle: each tool needs its own accessory
scenes.visual_carrier: man staggers through the door under more boxes each trip, wall still bare

changes.detail: the room starts filling with equipment

scenes.leads_to: the equipment needs somewhere to be organised
scenes.narration: He is not lazy. He is thorough. Those are different words.

scenes.action: builds a tool wall, then a rack for the tool wall's manuals
scenes.obstacle: the tool wall is going on the only free wall
scenes.visual_carrier: man hangs a huge pegboard across the exact spot where the shelf belongs

changes.detail: the pegboard now covers the target wall

scenes.leads_to: the shelf has no wall left

scenes.action: pushes boxes out; they pile against the door and window
scenes.obstacle: every box he moves blocks something else
scenes.visual_carrier: boxes seal the door, he is trapped inside the room with his tools

changes.detail: he can no longer leave or reach the wall

scenes.leads_to: trapped, he sees the one screw on the floor
scenes.narration: At this point the preparation was load-bearing.

scenes.action: finds the lone screw and, with no tools reachable, presses it into the plaster with his thumb
scenes.obstacle: nothing in reach to turn it
scenes.visual_carrier: he stares at the screw, then at the mountain, then twists the screw in with a coin

changes.detail: he realises the screw never needed the mountain

scenes.leads_to: a hung shelf needs only the board he forgot

scenes.action: hangs a single small book on the screw and sits on the box mountain
scenes.obstacle: he doubts one screw can hold anything
scenes.visual_carrier: one screw in a clear wall holds one small book while the room stays full of unopened boxes

changes.detail: relief turns to quiet pride, then a glance at the laser level

scenes.narration: He still has the laser level. For next time.

joke.payoff: he eyes the laser level again
joke.timing: hold two beats on his glance before cut
